entities.name: HGNC:5361
observations: ID2 (inhibitor of DNA binding 2) was investigated in cancer-cell responses to arsenic trioxide.

entities.name: Arsenic trioxide
observations: Arsenic trioxide (ATO) was tested for antitumor effects in cancer cells.

entities.name: PMID:25076250
observations: Zhang et al., Tumori (2014): ID2-specific silencing enhanced ATO-induced proliferation inhibition in Eca109 esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and BxPC3 pancreatic carcinoma cells.

entities.name: ID2–ATO antagonism
observations: In Eca109 and BxPC3 cancer cells, ID2 knockdown enhanced ATO-induced proliferation inhibition; this supports, but does not directly prove by overexpression, that ID2 upregulation antagonizes ATO.
